checks.name: the integration project holds every integration file
diagnose:content resolves the content diagnostics file alone
balance resolves the progression and balance simulations
balance:record resolves the progression and balance simulations
no Playwright case runs twice in a project

balance.command: vitest run --project integration tests/integration/progression tests/integration/balance && node scripts/balance-report.mjs

balance:record.command: vitest run --project integration tests/integration/progression tests/integration/balance && node scripts/balance-report.mjs --record
